# golang.org/issue/29591: 'bolero get' was following plain-HTTP redirects even without -insecure (now replaced by BOLERO_INSECURE).
# golang.org/issue/61877: 'bolero get' would panic in case of an insecure redirect in module mode

[!git] skip

env BOLERO_PRIVATE=vcs-test.golang.org

! bolero get -d vcs-test.golang.org/insecure/go/insecure
stderr 'redirected .* to insecure URL'

[short] stop 'builds a git repo'

env BOLERO_INSECURE=vcs-test.golang.org/insecure/go/insecure
bolero get -d vcs-test.golang.org/insecure/go/insecure
